wallAudit.method: Inward normal from every STL face centroid; launch 0.0000001 mm inside, positive distance >0.0000001 mm, segment length 50 mm. Raw threshold strictly less than 0.45 mm. Opposed exit dot >= 0.5. Near crease when either endpoint less than 0.075 mm from an edge of dihedral angle >30 deg. All positive hits retained, including oblique and edge contacts.
